name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: Enable users to easily find recycling facilities based on their location or other search criteria.
Allow users to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, managing notifications, and optimizing their recycling schedule.
Provide users with detailed and accurate information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and event schedules.
Offer users channels to provide feedback, report issues, and receive assistance regarding the application or recycling services.
Ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, correct, and comprehensive.
Effectively process and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to improve service quality and user satisfaction.
Establish and maintain effective communication channels between administrators and recycling facilities.
Protect sensitive user and facility information from unauthorized access, ensuring compliance with data privacy standards.
Enable facility representatives to independently update and maintain the details of their respective recycling centers.
Provide a direct channel for facility representatives to communicate issues or concerns to the site administrators.
Enable superusers to manage and update recycling center information to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
Allow superusers to directly answer questions from users regarding their specific recycling center.
lowLevelGoals: The system shall allow the user to retrieve a list of nearby recycling facilities based on their current GPS coordinates.
The system shall allow the user to search for recycling facilities by entering a specific address or zip code.
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed recycling facilities by the types of materials they accept (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed recycling facilities by their operational hours (e.g., open now, open weekends).
The system shall allow the user to add a recycling facility to their personal list of favorite facilities.
The system shall allow the user to remove a recycling facility from their personal list of favorite facilities.
The system shall allow the user to set preferences for receiving notifications about updates to their favorite facilities (e.g., changes in hours, new accepted materials).
The system shall allow the user to set up recurring reminders for their recycling schedule.
The system shall allow the user to view the phone number, email, and website of a specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the user to view the daily and weekly operational hours for a specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the user to view a comprehensive list of all materials accepted by a specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the user to view a schedule of upcoming special recycling events or collection drives hosted by a specific facility.
The system shall allow the user to submit general feedback or suggestions about the application's features and usability.
The system shall allow the user to report inaccuracies or issues with a specific recycling facility's information (e.g., incorrect hours, wrong address).
The system shall allow the user to send a support request or question directly to an administrator.
The system shall allow the administrator to create a new record for a recycling facility, including all its details.
The system shall allow the administrator to modify any detail of an existing recycling facility (e.g., address, contact, hours).
The system shall allow the administrator to remove a recycling facility record from the system.
The system shall allow the administrator to review and approve updates submitted by facility representatives or superusers.
The system shall allow the administrator to view a list of all feedback, issues, and support requests submitted by users.
The system shall allow the administrator to change the status of a user feedback item to 'resolved' after addressing it.
The system shall allow the administrator to send a direct message or email response to a specific user inquiry.
The system shall allow the administrator to send a message or notification to a specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the administrator to view a log of all past communications with specific recycling facilities.
The system shall allow the administrator to define and assign different access roles and permissions to users (e.g., user, facility representative, superuser).
The system shall allow the administrator to view logs of user and administrator access to the system and data.
The system shall allow the administrator to anonymize specific user data to comply with privacy regulations.
The system shall allow the facility representative to modify the phone number, email, and website for their specific facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to change the daily and weekly operational hours for their facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to add or remove materials from the list of accepted items at their facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to add new special events or modify existing ones for their facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to send a direct message to the site administrators regarding issues or concerns.
The system shall allow the facility representative to view replies to their messages from the site administrators.
The system shall allow the superuser to modify any detail of any recycling facility, regardless of ownership.
The system shall allow the superuser to review and either approve or reject pending update requests for any facility.
The system shall allow the superuser to publish changes to facility information directly without requiring further approval.
The system shall allow the superuser to view all user questions and feedback specifically directed at their associated recycling facility.
The system shall allow the superuser to send a direct response to a user's question about their specific recycling facility.
